raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

During MTP draft prefill only the last row of each prefill request is sampled, but attention runs over every row. This adds an opt-in mode that computes draft prefill attention only for the sampled rows; KV is still written for every token.

## Claims

- New `SpeculativeConfig.prune_draft_prefill_attention` (default off), for single-module MTP with the FlashInfer backend (XQA or trtllm-gen decode).
- Off by default because the sampled rows run on the decode kernel, so results are not bitwise identical.
- Warns at load when enabled but not applicable; FULL CUDA-graph draft prefills keep full attention.

## Validation

Not run yet. Planned:

```bash
pytest -v tests/v1/attention/test_trtllm_attention_integration.py -k draft_prefill_sampled_rows
pytest -v tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/mtp/qwen3_5/test_mtp.py -k prune_draft_prefill_attention
```

plus GSM8K and acceptance length with the option on and off.

## Details

Independent of the other open draft PRs in this series.

+            reason = impl.draft_prefill_rows_unsupported()
+            if reason is None:
+                logger.info("MTP draft prefill attention pruning enabled")
+                return impl
+        logger.warning("prune_draft_prefill_attention is ignored: %s", reason)
+        return None
+
+    def _prefill(
+        self,
+        num_reqs: int,
+        num_tokens: int,
+        attn_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None,
+        slot_mappings: dict[str, torch.Tensor] | None,
+        num_tokens_across_dp: torch.Tensor | None,
+        cudagraph_runtime_mode: CUDAGraphMode = CUDAGraphMode.NONE,
+        mm_inputs: tuple[list[torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        impl = self.draft_prefill_attn_impl
+        if (
+            impl is not None
+            and cudagraph_runtime_mode != CUDAGraphMode.FULL
+            and not torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
+        ):
+            from vllm.v1.attention.backends.flashinfer import DraftPrefillRows
+
+            rows = self.last_token_indices[:num_reqs]
+            impl.draft_prefill_rows = DraftPrefillRows(
+                rows=rows,
+                seq_lens=(self.input_buffers.positions[rows] + 1).to(torch.int32),
+                max_seq_len=self.draft_max_seq_len,
+            )
+        try:
+            super()._prefill(
+                num_reqs,
+                num_tokens,
+                attn_metadata,
+                slot_mappings,
+                num_tokens_across_dp,
+                cudagraph_runtime_mode,
+                mm_inputs,
+            )
+        finally:
+            if impl is not None:
+                impl.draft_prefill_rows = None
+
     def on_prefill_begin(self, num_reqs: int) -> None:
         # Step 0 computes its own top-k. Unconditional, so a step that died
         # midway cannot leave reuse mode on.
